description: Source code defining a serializable state class and a grain class for testing multifacet factory functionalities in an Orleans project. The grain interacts with interfaces IMultifacetReader and IMultifacetWriter, providing methods to get and set these interfaces.

classes.name: MultifacetFactoryTestGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class holding references to IMultifacetReader and IMultifacetWriter, used as grain state.

classes.name: MultifacetFactoryTestGrain
classes.description: Grain class implementing IMultifacetFactoryTestGrain, provides methods to get and set reader/writer interfaces.

methods.name: GetReader
methods.description: Returns the IMultifacetReader associated with the grain or provided as parameter.

methods.name: GetWriter
methods.description: Returns the IMultifacetWriter associated with the grain or provided as parameter.

methods.name: SetReader
methods.description: Sets the IMultifacetReader in the grain's state.

methods.name: SetWriter
methods.description: Sets the IMultifacetWriter in the grain's state.
